name: Half Joker
effect: Adds +20 Mult when 3 or fewer cards are played.
condition: Number of cards PLAYED (selected and played, including non-scoring cards) is <= 3. Scoring status is irrelevant.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Joker Stencil
effect: Gives XMult equal to the number of empty Joker slots, with every Joker Stencil counting as an empty slot.
condition: Applies when the computed value is > 1 (X1 does nothing).
notes: Each Stencil counts itself (and every other Stencil) as empty: 5 slots, 2 Stencils, no other jokers -> each Stencil gives X5.
Negative jokers raise the slot limit by 1, so they effectively do not occupy a slot. A Negative Stencil adds +1 to every Stencil.
Debuffed jokers still occupy slots. Consumables are irrelevant.
Blueprint/Brainstorm copy the Stencil's current XMult but do NOT count as Stencils themselves (they occupy a slot, lowering the value by 1).
Value is recomputed continuously, so buying/selling/destroying jokers changes it immediately.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Four Fingers
effect: Flushes and Straights can be made with 4 cards instead of 5.
condition: Always while owned (not copyable).
notes: Played hand must still have 4 or 5 cards to form these hands.
A 5-card hand containing a 4-card straight and a 4-card flush (possibly using different cards) is a Straight Flush.
Straight scoring includes every played card whose rank is part of the run (duplicates of a rank in the run also score).
Multiple copies do not stack further.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Mime
effect: Retriggers the held-in-hand abilities of every card held in hand one extra time.
condition: For each card held in hand that produced at least one held effect this pass (its own Steel X1.5, or a held-card joker effect such as Baron, Shoot the Moon, Raised Fist, Reserved Parking).
notes: Also applies to end-of-round held effects: Gold cards ($3) and Blue Seals (Planet) are retriggered at end of round.
Each Mime (and each Blueprint/Brainstorm copying Mime) adds one more retrigger; Red Seal on a held card adds another. Retriggers stack additively.
Does not retrigger a held card that had no effect; for Reserved Parking this means a failed roll is only retried when another held effect exists on that card.
Does NOT affect Blackboard (Blackboard is an independent check, not a per-card held ability).
Debuffed held cards produce no effects so are not retriggered.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Credit Card
effect: Lets money go down to -$20 (debt).
condition: Always while owned.
notes: Implemented as bankrupt threshold lowered by $20 per copy (multiple copies stack).
If sold while in debt you cannot buy anything until money is >= 0 again.
Interest is only paid when money >= $5; Bull/Bootstraps give nothing at <= $0.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Ceremonial Dagger
effect: When a Blind is selected, destroys the Joker immediately to its right and permanently gains Mult equal to twice that Joker's sell value.
condition: On selecting any Blind (Small, Big or Boss): a Joker exists directly to the right, it is not Eternal and not already being destroyed. In scoring: gives +current Mult if > 0.
notes: Rightmost Dagger destroys nothing. Eternal neighbour -> nothing destroyed and no gain.
Sell value = max(1, floor(cost/2)) + accumulated extra value (Egg, Gift Card); cost includes edition surcharges and discounts.
Blueprint/Brainstorm copy only the +Mult, never the destruction.
Not Perishable-compatible. Dagger can be moved freely during the round since destruction only happens at Blind selection.
Joker-order matters versus other blind-select jokers (resolved left to right).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Banner
effect: Adds +30 Chips for each discard remaining.
condition: discards_left > 0 at the moment the hand is scored (discards already used this round are not counted).
notes: Burglar sets discards to 0, making Banner give nothing that round.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Mystic Summit
effect: Adds +15 Mult when you have no discards remaining.
condition: discards_left == 0 at scoring time (used up, or removed by Burglar, etc.).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Marble Joker
effect: When a Blind is selected, adds one Stone card to the deck.
condition: On selecting any Blind.
random_parts: Underlying rank/suit of the Stone card is a random standard card (irrelevant: Stone cards have no rank/suit).
notes: The Stone card goes into the draw pile (not directly to hand).
Counts as a playing card added to the deck (Hologram +X0.25). Increases full-deck size (affects Erosion, Stone Joker, Driver's License).
Blueprint/Brainstorm copies add one extra Stone card each.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Loyalty Card
effect: Gives X4 Mult on every 6th hand played after this Joker was obtained.
condition: Let k = (total hands played this run) - (hands played when this Joker was created), evaluated during scoring before the current hand is counted. Fires when k mod 6 == 5, i.e. on the 6th, 12th, 18th... hand since acquisition. The counter spans rounds and antes.
notes: Counter is based on the run-wide hand count, so hands that a Boss Blind declares not allowed still advance it (but give no scoring).
A copy created with Ankh keeps the original's counter.
Blueprint/Brainstorm copy the X4 on the same hand it is active.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: 8 Ball
effect: Each scoring 8 has a 1 in 4 chance to create a Tarot card.
condition: Scoring card is an 8 (rank id 8) and there is a free consumable slot (pending creations count).
random_parts: 1 in 4 per scoring trigger of an 8 (each retrigger rolls again). Oops! All 6s doubles the numerator.
notes: No card is created if consumable slots are full.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Misprint
effect: Adds a random amount of Mult from 0 to 23 to each played hand.
condition: Always.
random_parts: Uniform random integer in [0, 23] drawn independently each hand (and for each Blueprint copy).
notes: Expected value +11.5 Mult.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Dusk
effect: Retriggers every scoring card once during the last hand of the round.
condition: hands_left == 0 at scoring time (the hand being played is the last available hand this round; hands_left is decremented before scoring).
notes: Does not fire on an earlier hand that happens to beat the Blind.
Retriggers stack with Red Seal and other retrigger jokers (additively).
Burglar/Grabber-type extra hands delay when the final hand occurs.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Raised Fist
effect: Adds Mult equal to double the rank value of the lowest-ranked card held in hand.
condition: Among cards held in hand (not Stone cards), picks the one with the lowest rank (2 lowest, Ace highest). Ties -> the RIGHTMOST such card. Gives +2x that card's base chip value (number cards = face value, J/Q/K = 10, Ace = 11).
notes: If the chosen card is debuffed it gives +0 (the joker does not fall back to another card).
Hiker bonus chips on the card are NOT included.
It is a held-card effect on that specific card, so Mime and a Red Seal on that card retrigger it.
Only fires if at least one non-Stone card is held.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Chaos the Clown
effect: Grants one free shop reroll in each shop.
condition: Always while owned (not copyable).
notes: Free rerolls are reset to the number of Chaos copies at the start of each round (so once per shop visit); multiple copies stack.
Buying it inside a shop grants a free reroll immediately; selling it removes an unused free reroll.
A free reroll does not advance the reroll price; the next paid reroll costs what it would have.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Fibonacci
effect: Each scoring Ace, 2, 3, 5 or 8 adds +8 Mult.
condition: Scoring card rank is Ace, 2, 3, 5 or 8.
notes: Retriggers fire it again. Stone cards never match.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Steel Joker
effect: Gives X(1 + 0.2 per Steel card in the full deck).
condition: At least one Steel card in the full deck (all owned playing cards: draw pile, hand, discard, played).
notes: Single multiplier, not one per card. Steel cards count wherever they are (also when debuffed).
Only appears in shop/packs if the deck contains at least one Steel card (enhancement gate).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)
spawn_condition: Only obtainable if there is at least 1 Steel card currently in the player's deck.

name: Scary Face
effect: Each scoring face card adds +30 Chips.
condition: Scoring card is a face card (J, Q, K; every card with Pareidolia). Debuffed cards never count.
notes: Retriggers fire it again.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Abstract Joker
effect: Adds +3 Mult for each Joker you own.
condition: Always; counts every card in the Joker area including itself, debuffed and Negative jokers.
notes: With 5 jokers: +15 Mult.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Delayed Gratification
effect: At end of round, earn $2 per unused discard if no discards were used that round.
condition: discards_used == 0 this round and discards_left > 0 when the round ends. Paid during the cash-out with other end-of-round money.
notes: The Hook's forced discards do not count as discards used.
Not copyable (end-of-round money is never copied). Debuffed -> no payout.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Hack
effect: Retriggers each scoring 2, 3, 4 or 5 once.
condition: Scoring card rank is 2, 3, 4 or 5.
notes: Stacks additively with Red Seal and other retrigger jokers; a retrigger replays the card's chips, enhancement, edition and all on-scored joker effects.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Pareidolia
effect: Every playing card counts as a face card.
condition: Always while owned (not copyable).
notes: Affects jokers (Scary Face, Smiley Face, Business Card, Photograph, Sock and Buskin, Midas Mask, Ride the Bus, Faceless Joker, Reserved Parking, Canio...) and Boss Blinds (The Plant debuffs every card).
Applies to Stone cards too. Debuffed cards are still not 'face' for joker purposes.
Ranks, suits and chip values are unchanged (Baron still needs real Kings, Hit the Road real Jacks, Triboulet real K/Q).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Gros Michel
effect: Adds +15 Mult; at end of each round has a 1 in 6 chance to be destroyed.
condition: +15 Mult always. End-of-round roll each round it is held.
random_parts: 1 in 6 destruction roll at end of every round (Oops! All 6s doubles to 2 in 6).
notes: When it destroys itself ('Extinct!') the run flag gros_michel_extinct is set: Gros Michel never appears again and Cavendish becomes able to appear.
Selling or other destruction (Dagger, Madness, Hex...) does NOT set the flag.
Cannot be Eternal. Blueprint copies only the +15 Mult.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)
spawn_condition: Only obtainable while Gros Michel has not yet gone "extinct" during the current run.

name: Even Steven

condition: Scoring card rank is 2, 4, 6, 8 or 10 (face cards and Aces excluded).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Scholar

condition: Scoring card is an Ace.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Business Card
effect: Each scoring face card has a 1 in 2 chance to earn $2.
condition: Scoring card is a face card (non-debuffed; all cards with Pareidolia).
random_parts: Independent 1 in 2 roll per scoring trigger (retriggers roll again).
notes: Money counts for Bull/Bootstraps later in the same hand (dollar buffer) but not for Vagabond.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Supernova
effect: Adds Mult equal to the number of times the played poker hand has been played this run.
condition: Always; the count INCLUDES the current play (first-ever Flush gives +1).
notes: Retroactive: counts plays made before this joker was bought.
Uses the hand type actually scored (e.g. Full House counts Full House plays, not Pair plays).
Hands a Boss Blind declares not allowed still increase the play count (but give no scoring).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Ride the Bus
effect: Gains +1 Mult for each consecutive hand played without a scoring face card; resets to 0 when a face card scores.
condition: Before scoring: if any SCORING card is a face card (J/Q/K, or any card with Pareidolia; debuffed cards are not faces) -> Mult resets to 0; otherwise Mult += 1. Then gives +current Mult if > 0.
notes: The +1 for the current hand applies to that same hand.
Non-scoring face cards in the played hand do not reset it.
Not Perishable-compatible. Blueprint copies only the +Mult (not the scaling or reset).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Space Joker
effect: Each played hand has a 1 in 4 chance to level up its poker hand before scoring.
condition: Every allowed played hand.
random_parts: 1 in 4 per hand (each Blueprint/Brainstorm copy rolls independently). Oops! All 6s -> 2 in 4.
notes: The level-up happens before chips/mult are read, so the current hand already scores at the new level.
Does not count as a Planet card used (no Constellation, no Satellite).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Egg
effect: Gains $3 of sell value at the end of every round.
condition: End of every round while held.
notes: Base sell value $2 (cost $4); after n rounds sell value = 2 + 3n (before Gift Card etc.).
Feeds Ceremonial Dagger and Swashbuckler. Not copyable.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Burglar
effect: When a Blind is selected, gain +3 hands and lose all discards for that round.
condition: On selecting any Blind.
notes: Applied at blind selection, so selling/debuffing Burglar mid-round does not undo it.
Copyable: each Blueprint/Brainstorm copy adds another +3 hands.
Ceremonial Dagger to its left destroys it before it acts.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Blackboard
effect: Gives X3 Mult if every card left in hand is a Spade or Club.
condition: Every card held in hand (after the play) counts as Spades or Clubs; vacuously true with 0 cards held. Wild cards count (unless debuffed); debuffed non-Wild cards still count by their printed suit; any Stone card held breaks it.
notes: Not affected by Mime (it is not a per-card held ability).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Runner
effect: Gains +15 Chips whenever the played hand contains a Straight; gives its accumulated Chips.
condition: Played hand CONTAINS a Straight: true for Straight and Straight Flush (incl. Royal Flush). With Four Fingers a 4-card run counts; with Shortcut single-rank gaps are allowed. Ace can be high or low but straights do not wrap. Gain happens before scoring; then gives +current Chips.
notes: The gain applies to the current hand. Not Perishable-compatible. Blueprint copies only the chips.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Ice Cream
effect: Gives +100 Chips, losing 5 Chips after every hand played; melts at 0.
condition: Always gives current Chips. After each hand played (including hands that score nothing because a Boss Blind disallowed them), Chips -= 5; if that would reach 0 it is destroyed instead.
notes: Gives 100, 95, ..., 5 over 20 hands, then is destroyed after the 20th.
Sell value does not change (sell before it melts). Not Eternal-compatible.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: DNA
effect: If the first hand of the round is a single card, adds a permanent copy of it to the deck and puts the copy in hand.
condition: First hand of the round (no hands played yet this round) and exactly 1 card played.
notes: The copy keeps enhancement, edition, seal and Hiker bonus chips; it is made before scoring (so Vampire/Midas Mask to its left change what is copied).
Counts as a playing card added (Hologram +X0.25).
Copyable: each Blueprint/Brainstorm copy adds another copy. Hanging Chad does not create extra copies.
A hand disallowed by the Boss Blind (e.g. The Psychic) does not trigger it.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Splash
effect: Every played card counts as a scoring card.
condition: Always while owned (not copyable).
notes: All played cards score: they add chips, trigger enhancements/seals/editions and on-scored jokers, can be retriggered.
Hand type is still determined normally. Hanging Chad then targets the leftmost played card.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gains X0.1 Mult each time a Planet card is used.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Each scoring card permanently gains +5 Chips.
condition: Every scoring card, every time it is triggered (each retrigger adds another +5).

effect: Earn $5 when 3 or more face cards are discarded at once.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gains +1 Mult per hand played and loses 1 Mult per discard (never below 0).
condition: +1 before scoring of each allowed hand (applies to that hand). -1 once per discard action regardless of cards discarded. Gives +current Mult if > 0.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Earn $4 if the played hand type matches the listed poker hand; the listed hand changes at the end of each round.
condition: Played hand TYPE equals the target exactly (the hand as named, not hands it contains). Target re-rolled at end of every round to a random visible hand type different from the current one.
random_parts: Target hand: uniform among visible poker hands except the current target (secret hands are only eligible once played this run).
notes: Each copy rolls its own target independently (unlike Mail-In Rebate/Castle/Ancient/Idol, which are shared).
Copyable: Blueprint pays another $4 on a match.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gives X3 Mult; at end of each round has a 1 in 1000 chance to be destroyed.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gives X3 Mult if this poker hand type was already played earlier this round.

effect: Gains +3 Mult whenever a Booster Pack is skipped.
condition: Pressing Skip in any opened Booster Pack (shop-bought or from tags). Once per pack skipped. Gives +current Mult if > 0.

Not Perishable-compatible.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: When a Small or Big Blind is selected, gains X0.5 Mult and destroys a random other Joker.
condition: On selecting a non-Boss Blind: always +X0.5; destroys a random Joker that is not itself, not Eternal, not already being destroyed (if any). Does nothing on Boss Blinds. Gives current XMult if > 1.
random_parts: Which Joker is destroyed is uniform among eligible Jokers.
notes: Gain happens even if nothing can be destroyed. It can destroy other copies of Madness.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Square Joker
effect: Gains +4 Chips if exactly 4 cards are played; gives its accumulated Chips.
condition: Before scoring: number of cards PLAYED is exactly 4 (scoring irrelevant, debuffed allowed). Then gives +current Chips if > 0.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Séance
effect: Creates a random Spectral card if the played hand contains a Straight Flush.
condition: Played hand contains a Straight Flush (Straight Flush / Royal Flush; with Four Fingers the straight and flush may use different 4-card sets). Needs a free consumable slot.
notes: Cannot create The Soul or Black Hole.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: When a Blind is selected, creates up to 2 Common Jokers if there is room.
condition: On selecting any Blind, if (jokers owned + pending) < joker slot limit; creates min(2, free slots).
random_parts: Created jokers are random Commons (normal pool rules; can roll editions incl. Negative). Never get Eternal/Perishable/Rental stickers except via challenge rules.
notes: With Showman it can create Riff-Raff/duplicates. Can create Cavendish if Gros Michel is extinct.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Removes the Enhancement from every scoring Enhanced card and gains X0.1 Mult per card.
condition: Before scoring: each SCORING card with any Enhancement (Bonus, Mult, Wild, Glass, Steel, Stone, Gold, Lucky) that is not debuffed loses it; +X0.1 each. Gives current XMult if > 1.
notes: Removed enhancements do not apply this hand (Glass gives no X2 and cannot break; Stone gives no +50 but the card still scores; Wild removal does not change the hand type).
Seals and editions are untouched. Only the leftmost Vampire strips cards; order vs Midas Mask matters (Midas left of Vampire -> faces turn Gold then get eaten).
Not Perishable-compatible. Blueprint copies only the XMult.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Shortcut
effect: Straights may contain one-rank gaps between cards (e.g. 2 4 5 7 9 is a Straight).
condition: Always while owned (not copyable).
notes: A gap of exactly one missing rank may occur between any adjacent cards, repeatedly (2 4 6 8 10 is a Straight), but two consecutive missing ranks break it.
No wrap-around; Ace is high (after K) or low (before 2).
Combines with Four Fingers.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Hologram
effect: Gains X0.25 Mult every time a playing card is added to your deck.
condition: Each playing card added to the deck after acquisition (Standard pack picks, playing cards bought in shop, DNA, Marble Joker, Certificate, Cryptid, Familiar/Grim/Incantation). Gives current XMult if > 1.
notes: Only gaining matters; destroying the added cards later does not reduce it.
Not retroactive; not Perishable-compatible.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Vagabond
effect: Creates a Tarot card when a hand is played while you have $4 or less.
condition: Money <= $4 when the hand is scored, using the money total from before this hand's payouts (money earned by the same hand's Gold Seals, Business Card, etc. is not counted). Needs a free consumable slot.
notes: In debt (Credit Card) it always qualifies.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Baron
effect: Each King held in hand gives X1.5 Mult.
condition: Card held in hand (not played) is a King and not debuffed.
notes: Retriggered by Mime and by a Red Seal on the held King (each retrigger is another X1.5).
Pareidolia does not make other ranks Kings.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Cloud 9
effect: Earn $1 at end of round for each 9 in your full deck.
condition: Counts every 9 among all owned playing cards (Stone cards excluded, debuffed 9s included). Paid at cash-out.
notes: Standard deck: $4 per round. Not copyable.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Earn $1 at end of round; the payout grows by $2 each time a Boss Blind is defeated.
condition: Pays every round. When a Boss Blind is beaten, the +$2 increase is applied before that round's payout.
notes: Not copyable; not Perishable-compatible.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Obelisk
effect: Gains X0.2 Mult for each consecutive hand that is not your most played poker hand; resets to X1 otherwise.
condition: Before scoring (play counts already include the current hand): if the played hand type's run play count is STRICTLY greater than that of every other visible hand type -> reset to X1; otherwise (some other visible type has >= as many plays) -> +X0.2. Gives current XMult if > 1.
notes: Ties are safe: playing a hand type that is tied for most played (after counting this play) still gains.
Hands disallowed by the Boss Blind neither gain nor reset (but do increase that hand's play count).
Not Perishable-compatible. Blueprint copies only the XMult.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Midas Mask
effect: Turns every scoring face card into a Gold card.
condition: Before scoring: each SCORING card that is a face card (non-debuffed; all cards with Pareidolia) gets the Gold enhancement, replacing any existing enhancement.
notes: Gold cards do nothing when played; they pay $3 if held at end of round in later rounds.
Overwrites Glass/Steel/Lucky etc. Not copyable.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Luchador
effect: Sell this Joker during a Boss Blind to disable that Boss Blind.
condition: Sold while the current Blind is a Boss Blind that is not already disabled, and Luchador is not debuffed.

Blueprint/Brainstorm copying Luchador: selling the Blueprint/Brainstorm also disables the Boss Blind.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: The first scoring face card gives X2 Mult when scored.

Applies after the card's own enhancement/edition contribution for that trigger.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: At end of round, adds $1 of sell value to every Joker and consumable you hold.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gives +5 hand size, which drops by 1 at the end of each round; destroyed when it reaches 0.

effect: Each face card held in hand has a 1 in 2 chance to earn $1.
condition: Card held in hand is a face card (non-debuffed; all cards with Pareidolia).
random_parts: 1 in 2 per held face card per hand.
notes: Mime/Red Seal only retrigger a held card that produced an effect, so a failed roll is only retried if some other held effect (Steel, Baron, Shoot the Moon...) fired on that card.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Mail-In Rebate
effect: Earn $5 for each discarded card of the listed rank; the rank changes every round.
condition: Each discarded card (not debuffed) whose rank equals the current target rank.
random_parts: Target rank re-rolled at end of every round (and at run start) by picking a uniformly random non-Stone card from the full deck, so common ranks are more likely and the same rank can repeat. Defaults to Ace if the deck has no ranked cards.
notes: All copies share the same target rank. Copyable. The Hook's forced discards also pay.

effect: Earn an extra $1 of interest per $5 held at end of round.

notes: Default cap $25 -> max interest $5 normally, $10 with one To the Moon. Seed Money/Money Tree raise the cap to $50/$100.
Stacks per copy. No effect with Green Deck/no-interest modifiers. Not copyable.

effect: 1 in 2 chance to create a Tarot card when any Booster Pack is opened.

effect: Adds +1 Mult for every Tarot card used this run.

notes: Not copyable.

notes: Each retrigger of a Lucky card can trigger again. Only appears if the deck has a Lucky card. Not Perishable-compatible.

spawn_condition: Only obtainable if there is at least 1 Lucky card currently in the player's deck.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: If the first discard of the round is a single card, destroys it and earns $3.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gains +2 Mult every time the shop is rerolled.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gains +2 Mult whenever the played hand contains a Two Pair.
condition: Played hand CONTAINS a Two Pair: true for Two Pair, Full House and Flush House (two exact pairs, or one exact triple plus one exact pair), and a Flush with two repeated ranks. notes: Not Perishable-compatible.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Each scoring card of the listed suit gives X1.5 Mult; the suit changes at end of round.
condition: Scoring card counts as the current suit (Wild cards always; Smeared Joker pairs).
random_parts: At end of every round the suit changes to one of the 3 OTHER suits uniformly (deck composition ignored). Initial suit uniform among all 4.
notes: All copies share the same suit.
Fires once per scoring trigger, so each retrigger (Red Seal, Hack, Sock and Buskin, Dusk, Seltzer, Hanging Chad, Blueprint-copied retriggers) fires it again.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Ramen
effect: Gives X2 Mult, losing X0.01 for every card discarded; destroyed when it would fall to X1.
condition: Every card discarded (per card, including The Hook's forced discards) -> -X0.01. If the result would be <= X1 it is destroyed instead.
notes: Destroyed on the 100th card discarded (it reaches X1.01 after 99).
Non-scoring played cards are not discards. Cannot be Eternal.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Walkie Talkie
effect: Each scoring 10 or 4 adds +10 Chips and +4 Mult.
condition: Scoring card rank is 10 or 4.
notes: Retriggers fire it again.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Retriggers every scoring card once for the next 10 hands, then is used up.
condition: Every scoring card of every played hand while hands remain. Counter -1 after each hand played (including hands the Boss Blind disallows); destroyed when the counter would reach 0 (after the 10th hand).
notes: Blueprint copies add another retrigger but do not consume extra charges.
Cannot be Eternal.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gains +3 Chips per discarded card of the listed suit; the suit changes every round.
condition: Each discarded card (not debuffed) that counts as the target suit (Wild cards and Smeared Joker pairs count). Gives +current Chips if > 0.
random_parts: Target suit re-rolled at end of every round (and run start) from a uniformly random non-Stone card in the full deck (weighted by deck suit composition, may repeat). Defaults to Spades if no suited cards.
notes: All copies share the same suit. The Hook's forced discards also count.
Not Perishable-compatible. Blueprint copies only the Chips.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Each scoring face card adds +5 Mult.
condition: Scoring card is a face card (non-debuffed; every card with Pareidolia).
notes: Retriggers fire it again.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Gains X0.25 Mult for each card sold; resets to X1 when a Boss Blind is defeated.
condition: Any Joker or consumable sold (other than Campfire itself) -> +X0.25. At end of a Boss Blind round it resets to X1. Gives current XMult if > 1.
notes: Destroying cards (Dagger, Hex, using consumables) does not count; only selling.

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

name: Golden Ticket
effect: Each scoring Gold card earns $4.
condition: Scoring card has the Gold enhancement (at scoring time).
notes: Midas Mask applies Gold before scoring, so Midas-converted faces pay immediately; Vampire to the left strips Gold first.
Only appears if the deck has a Gold card (enhancement gate).
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)
spawn_condition: Only obtainable if there is at least 1 Gold card currently in the player's deck.

effect: Prevents a loss if you scored at least 25% of the Blind's requirement, then destroys itself.
condition: At round end, if the Blind was not beaten (game would be over) and round chips / blind chips >= 0.25.

Wiki: does not save you when you run out of cards (see open questions).

effect: Gives X3 Mult on the final hand of the round.
condition: hands_left == 0 at scoring time (this is the last available hand of the round).

effect: Retriggers every scoring face card once.
condition: Scoring card is a face card (non-debuffed; every card with Pareidolia).

source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

effect: Adds Mult equal to the total sell value of all your other Jokers.

condition: Gives +sum if > 0; includes debuffed jokers, excludes itself and consumables.

name: Flower Pot
effect: Gives X3 Mult if the scoring cards include a Diamond, a Club, a Heart and a Spade.
condition: Among SCORING cards: each non-Wild card is assigned to the first matching suit of Hearts, Diamonds, Spades, Clubs that is still missing (printed suit counts even if debuffed); then each Wild card (not debuffed) fills one missing suit. Triggers if all four suits are covered (needs >= 4 scoring cards).
notes: Each card fills at most one suit, but with Smeared Joker a red card can fill Hearts or Diamonds and a black card Spades or Clubs, so two red + two black scoring cards suffice.
Debuffed Wild cards count for nothing (bug in 1.0.1).

name: Blueprint
effect: Copies the ability of the Joker immediately to its right.
condition: A Joker exists directly to its right. The copy is evaluated at Blueprint's own position in the joker order.
notes: Copies every context the target reacts to while Blueprint is the one being called: on-scored, held, retriggers, before-scoring (e.g. Space Joker, DNA, To Do List), independent XMult/+Mult/+Chips, other-joker (Baseball Card), blind select (Burglar, Cartomancer, Marble, Riff-Raff), discard (Burnt Joker, Faceless, Mail-In Rebate), booster open (Hallucination), end of shop (Perkeo), round start (Certificate), selling (selling Blueprint copying Luchador/Diet Cola triggers them).

Never copies: end-of-round money (Golden Joker, Cloud 9, Rocket, Satellite, Delayed Gratification), passive rule changes (hand size, discards, Four Fingers, Pareidolia, Showman, Chicot...), scaling/increments and resets (only the current value is copied), self-destruction/destruction effects (Dagger, Madness's destroy, Trading Card, Sixth Sense), editions and stickers of the target, debuffed targets.
Chance-based targets roll independently for the copy.
Blueprint copying Brainstorm copies Brainstorm's target (and vice versa); chains are followed but self-loops stop.
Rightmost Blueprint does nothing. Blueprint is itself copyable.
source: game code v1.0.1o (game.lua P_CENTERS config; card.lua Card:calculate_joker)

notes: Not Perishable-compatible. Blueprint copies only the Chips.

condition: Scoring card has the target rank AND counts as the target suit (Wild cards and Smeared Joker pairs match on suit).

name: Seeing Double
effect: Gives X2 Mult if the scoring cards include a Club and a card of another suit.
condition: Among SCORING cards: non-Wild cards are counted for every suit they count as (debuffed cards count for nothing); then each Wild card fills Clubs first, else another missing suit. Triggers if Clubs >= 1 and (Hearts or Diamonds or Spades) >= 1.
notes: With Smeared Joker a single scoring Spade or Club satisfies it by itself.

name: Matador
effect: Earn $8 whenever a played hand triggers the Boss Blind's ability.
condition: During a Boss Blind the played hand: contains a scoring debuffed card (The Window/Head/Club/Goad suit debuffs, The Plant, The Pillar, Verdant Leaf), or is disallowed (The Psychic <5 cards, The Eye repeat type, The Mouth other type), or is halved by The Flint, or is levelled down by The Arm (hand level >= 2), or matches The Ox's most played hand.
notes: The Hook, The Tooth and Crimson Heart never trigger it (their trigger flag is cleared before scoring).
A debuffed card must be in the scoring hand to count. Pays per hand. Copyable.
